member.name: M:Jellyfin.Plugin.Template.Api.PasswordStrengthController.ChangePasswordAsync(Jellyfin.Plugin.Template.Api.Models.ChangePasswordRequest)
member.summary: Changes the authenticated user's password after verifying their current password. The new password must meet the strength policy.
member.remarks: SECURITY: Verifies the current password before accepting any change, protecting against stolen session tokens being used to hijack accounts. Rate-limited to 5 failures per 15 minutes. Request bodies are never logged.
member.returns: 204 No Content on success; 400/401/429 on failure.

member.name: M:Jellyfin.Plugin.Template.Api.PasswordStrengthController.ForceResetAsync(Jellyfin.Plugin.Template.Api.Models.ForceResetRequest)
member.summary: Flags all non-admin users for a mandatory password reset and revokes their active sessions. Requires admin role plus password re-confirmation.
member.remarks: SECURITY: Re-authenticates the calling admin before acting, preventing misuse of an already-authenticated admin session (e.g. unattended terminal). All affected sessions are immediately revoked so users cannot continue without resetting their password.
member.returns: 204 No Content on success; 401 if re-authentication fails.
